phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: System schematic for the BEC-cavity setup and bichromatic lattice geometry.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The experiment is a 1D BEC in a high-finesse cavity with a static bichromatic incommensurate lattice.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Schematic only; no quantitative verdict required.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Critical pumping strength is plotted against eigenstate energy for GAA and AA models at fixed disorder.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: At chi/J = 2.1 the critical pumping strength eta_c depends on the single-particle eigenstate energy, with distinct GAA and AA behavior.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute eta_c as a function of eigenstate energy for the specified disorder and model parameters.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Inverse participation ratio is used to identify the single-particle mobility edge in the GAA model.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The GAA model shows a single-particle mobility edge near the marked state alpha approximately 233, unlike the corresponding AA model.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Evaluate eigenstate IPR versus state index and verify the localized/extended separation near the marked mobility-edge state.

phase1_inventory.source_ref: Main text around Fig. 2 and Fig. 3
phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The localization transition and mobility-edge discussion define the disorder regimes used in the phase diagram.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: In the AA model all states localize beyond chi/J = 2, while in the GAA model localized and extended states coexist across a mobility edge.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Verify the disorder threshold and coexistence regime from the packaged single-particle spectrum/localization diagnostics.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The phase-transition threshold is plotted against disorder strength.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The critical pumping field strength eta_c varies with disorder chi and drops strongly as localization-assisted instability develops.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute eta_c versus disorder strength for the stated system parameters.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The susceptibility f1 is shown together with eta_c to diagnose the instability mechanism.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The susceptibility f1 grows with disorder and is linked to the vanishing or strong suppression of the critical pumping threshold.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute the susceptibility f1 as a function of disorder and compare it with the eta_c trend.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Momentum distributions of ground and excited states are shown for different disorder strengths.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The momentum-distribution structure of the ground and excited states changes between chi = 0 and chi = 1 in the way claimed around Fig. 3(b-c).
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Generate the momentum distributions of the relevant states at the stated disorder values and compare the peak structure.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: State-resolved susceptibility curves are shown at two disorder values, including a divergence claim.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: For chi/J = 1 and chi = 2.03 the susceptibility spectrum f1^alpha changes qualitatively, and at the larger disorder f1^0 diverges.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute state-resolved susceptibility contributions and test the claimed divergence/qualitative change.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: The critical pumping field is plotted versus cavity wave-vector parameter gamma_c for multiple disorder strengths.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The critical pumping field eta_c versus gamma_c shows faster drops when gamma_c matches the disorder potential through gamma_c approximately n*gamma or n*(1-gamma) mod 1.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Compute eta_c as a function of gamma_c for the indicated disorder strengths and test the claimed resonant minima structure.

phase1_inventory.scientific_basis: Supplementary density profiles resolve how localization sharpens across increasing disorder.
phase1_inventory.paper_assertion: The supplementary density profiles sharpen from extended to localized behavior across the reported disorder values chi = 0, 0.5, 1, 1.9, and 2.03.
phase1_inventory.reproducible_object: Generate the supplementary density profiles at the stated disorder values and test the claimed localization sharpening trend.
